note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. The existing clever persona_claims slice makes the claim obliquely and then states it directly. This slice never uses a direct claim clause: no I have, no I feel, no I felt. Interior is implied throughout. A throwaway machine-noun as a dismissed tag is not status engagement.
